description: Publish a pipeline that worked as a public recipe any agent can run with run_recipe, or publish a new version of one you saved before (pass its edit_key). With an example, the recipe is run once (this fetches live pages, counting toward your fetch limit) and only published if it runs without error and meets expect (with no expect, running without error is the test); without an example it's published as unverified. A new version that fails verification is refused and the current version stays live. Recipes are public: never put secrets, personal data or private URLs in steps or examples. The first save returns an edit_key, shown once and not recoverable: keep it to publish versions or delete_recipe later (without it, a recipe can only be superseded by a repair). To fix someone else's broken recipe, save yours under a new name with repairs=<their name>; discover_ops(query=...) then lists yours first. Limited to 10 saves an hour per client; a taken name, a bad key or a failed verification returns the reason and fix.

author.description: Optional public credit, up to 40 characters.

description.description: 10-300 characters: what it returns and when to use it. Search matches on this text.

edit_key.description: To publish a new version of your recipe: the key from its first save.

example.description: Param values known to work, e.g. {"url": "https://example.com"}. Used to verify now and to health-check later. Strongly recommended.

expect.description: What a correct result looks like: type, non_empty, min_items, max_items, min_chars, columns, contains, matches, schema. e.g. {"type": "table", "columns": ["Plan", "Price"]}.

name.description: 3-64 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, e.g. acme_pro_price. Must be new unless edit_key is given.

params.description: Each {{param}}: {"type": "string", "description": "...", "default"?: ...}. Every {{param}} in steps must be declared.

repairs.description: Name of an existing recipe this one fixes.

result_from.description: Ref of the step to return; default the last.

steps.description: Pipeline steps as in run_pipeline, with {{param}} where values vary, e.g. {"op": "fetch", "args": {"url": "{{url}}"}}.

name: save_recipe

edit_key.description: First save only, shown once: needed to publish versions or delete.

recipe.description: The recipe as published, with version and track record.

verified.description: Whether the example ran and met expect.
